news.title: Developers employing 50 or more workers at Noida construction sites get 15 days to set up crèches
news.para: The Noida administration has mandated that construction sites establish crèches within a strict timeline of fifteen days. This initiative comes in response to growing concerns for children's well-being amidst construction activities. Facilities must maintain cleanliness and hygiene, distance from potential hazards, and ensure staff are police-verified.

news.title: Regularise minor building violations: Plea seeks one-time relief policy for Sushant Lok 1, 2 and 3
news.para: Residents of Sushant Lok are advocating for a dedicated policy addressing minor building deviations. This initiative seeks to formalize technical irregularities while safeguarding genuine buyers. Advocates argue that it's unjust to classify unsuspecting purchasers as intentional lawbreakers. A proposed composition system could not only generate funds but also offer legal clarity, potentially resolving a significant administrative challenge for many families.

news.title: Paperless land registration sees poor response in Buxar, as villagers struggle with digital process
news.para: In Buxar district, the number of land and property registrations has decreased since August 3. The shift to a digital registration system is proving difficult for elderly villagers and residents. According to deed writers, many rural individuals are wary of the new paperless approach. The Aadhaar-linked system aims to enhance security and reduce fraud, prompting officials to recommend awareness initiatives to foster better understanding and acceptance among the community.

news.title: Over half of Chennai metro phase II complete, ballastless track laying at 67km
news.para: More than half of Chennai Metro Rail's Phase II project is complete. Ballast-less track laying has progressed to about 67 kilometers so far. Project timelines were revised due to the Covid-19 pandemic and other delays. Completed sections undergo multiple quality and safety checks before operations begin. The first operational stretch awaits inauguration after completing mandatory safety clearances.

news.title: Homeowners in Gurugram to move court against blanket action on 2,500 houses in DLF 3
news.para: A wave of action is set to hit more than 2,500 houses in Gurgaon over supposed construction infractions. Homeowners are gearing up to legally contest this blanket enforcement, asserting that not all properties are equally at fault. They urge for assessments based on each case and a more realistic compliance strategy. The authorities remain active in their enforcement across DLF Phase 3.

news.title: Ghaziabad development body set to clear stalled Ansal township map after SC intervention
news.para: Ghaziabad Development Authority board will approve Ansal township layout on Friday.  This decision follows Supreme Court criticism of authorities' delayed approvals.  The court directed the state government and GDA to consider the proposal.  One City Infrastructure Pvt Ltd is tasked with completing the stalled project.  This action offers relief to 1,600 homebuyers waiting for their flats.

news.title: Telangana RERA orders ₹42 lakh refund with interest to two buyers over unregistered plot project
news.para: Telangana RERA ordered a consultancy firm to refund buyers ₹42.2 lakh with interest. The firm marketed plots in an unregistered project, violating RERA Act provisions. Buyers paid ₹52.2 lakh for two plots before seeking cancellation and a refund. The authority also found the developer and landowner in violation of the Act. Project registration is now mandated, and further sales are halted until compliance.

news.title: Enforcement directorate searches seven premises in Tashee Group money-laundering case
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate conducted search and survey operations at seven premises in Delhi-NCR in connection with a money-laundering investigation involving Tashee Land Developers, KNS Infracon and Soni Infratech. The case relates to allegations of cheating homebuyers and investors in Gurugram projects.

news.title: US appeals court upholds big real estate settlement despite class members' objections
news.para: A federal appeals court has confirmed an important settlement that resolves various antitrust allegations, allowing a settlement of over one billion dollars to progress. This resolution centers on claims regarding inflated real estate agent commissions. The changes in negotiation and disclosure rules promise to support the affected class. Key players in this accord include the National Association of Realtors and HomeServices of America.

news.title: China Evergrande Group's founder sentenced to life in prison
news.para: China Evergrande founder Hui Ka Yan received a life sentence for fraud.  His company faced collapse, impacting China's economy and financial markets.  Evergrande defaulted on significant liabilities, symbolizing a property sector crisis.  The court also fined the company and sentenced other senior executives.  Creditors await recovery as the liquidation process continues slowly.

news.title: Krishvi Group to invest ₹760 crore in three Bengaluru housing projects
news.para: Krishvi Group will invest ₹760 crore across three residential projects in Bengaluru. The developments, spread across 6.5 acres in Hennur and HBR Layout, have a gross development value of about ₹1,050 crore.

news.title: Brigade Group leases 1.62 lakh sq ft office space to HealthEdge in Thiruvananthapuram
news.para: Brigade Group has leased about 1.62 lakh sq ft office space to US-based healthcare technology company HealthEdge at Brigade Square in Thiruvananthapuram. The space is spread across 11 floors of Brigade’s first IT office building in Technopark Phase 1.

news.title: IndiQube leases 1,300 seats to global audio platform in Bengaluru
news.para: IndiQube has leased nearly 1,300 seats to a well-known global audio series platform in a deal valued at close to ₹68 crore. Previously located at IndiQube's Koramangala site, the client is set to transition to a more expansive tech park on Bengaluru's Outer Ring Road.

news.title: Three in four occupiers plan to expand office portfolio in India: Survey
news.para: About 75% of office occupiers surveyed by CBRE plan to expand their office portfolios in India over the next two years. The share of occupiers planning significant expansion of over 30% has increased to 30% in 2026 from 18% in 2025.

news.title: Delhi master plan 2047 unveiled; envisages 40 lakh affordable homes
news.para: The Delhi Master Plan 2047 envisages development of around 40 lakh new affordable housing units, redevelopment of existing residential areas and planned urban expansion through land pooling. The plan also proposes transit-oriented development, higher FAR incentives, regularisation of unauthorised colonies and conservation of heritage assets.

news.title: Absconding Kanpur-based builder nabbed in ₹52 lakh fraud case
news.para: Kalyanpur police have taken a real-estate director into custody over a Rs 52 lakh fraud case, where he allegedly lured investors with the deceptive promise of doubled investments and land deals within five years. This individual already faced nineteen prior allegations, with three associates arrested earlier this week. Authorities are actively pursuing two other directors who have not yet been apprehended.

news.title: Ghaziabad civic body launches one-time settlement for 60,000 property tax defaulters
news.para: Ghaziabad Municipal Corporation offers a settlement scheme for over sixty thousand property tax defaulters.  This initiative waives twelve percent annual penalty charges for full payment of dues.  Defaulters must declare their intent to pay by November fourteenth.  The scheme is valid until December fifteenth, aiming to recover significant revenue.  Property tax collection for 2024-25 reached six hundred nine crore rupees.

news.title: Water crisis hits 4,338 Taloja flats, Navi Mumbai residents protest outside Cidco Bhawan
news.para: Asawari Gruhasankul residents protested Cidco Bhawan over persistent water scarcity issues.  They demanded adequate potable water supply for their 4,338 apartments.  Residents expressed frustration with poor quality tanker water and daily bottled water expenses.  Cidco authorities promised to resolve the water crisis within fifteen to twenty days.  They also stated that booster pump usage by societies would face legal action.

news.title: Gujarat: Popular Builders owner Dashrath Patel denied bail in two cases
news.para: A sessions court has refused bail to Dashrath Patel, the owner of Popular Builders, in connection with two land grabbing allegations. His brother, Raman Patel, is serving a four-year prison term for a related Chekhla land case. Both have been charged with forgery and cheating linked to land deals. The court's decision reflects concerns about potential witness tampering and has significant implications for their ongoing legal battle.

news.title: DLF-3 residents in Gurugram seek policy for workforce housing amid razing
news.para: Residents of DLF-3 organized a large meeting to voice their demands for a housing policy that benefits local workers. They protested against government actions of sealing and demolitions that jeopardize accommodation for the workforce. Advocating for the right to remedy property violations through payments, they emphasized the need for a comprehensive legal framework encompassing guest and rental housing options.
